angle: Instead of touring the product, this reel follows one job end to end: four different channel exports going in through a single import screen, with duplicates shown and combined instead of silently dropped.

hook.question: Which list is the real one?

scenes.vo: Every list you already own comes in through the same import screen.
scenes.focus: the Import button above the leads table

scenes.vo: Excel, CSV or TSV uploads, and the columns are detected by header.

chip.title: Columns auto-detected
chip.sub: Up to 5,000 rows and five megabytes

scenes.vo: Nothing is written until you confirm the preview, and duplicates are listed.
scenes.focus: the duplicate rows in the preview

chip.title: Preview before write
chip.sub: Matched on phone, or on email

scenes.vo: A repeat buyer is combined, so the owner, stage and history survive.
scenes.focus: the timeline note naming the file and the row

chip.title: Combined, not dropped
chip.sub: Tags union, budget widens, notes append

scenes.vo: The new leads then reach your agents by your own distribution rules.
scenes.focus: the owner name on each new lead

chip.title: Straight to an agent
chip.sub: Round robin, load balanced, or by source

cta.tag: One import screen for every list
cta.note: CSV, TSV and Excel. Duplicates combined.
